{{Top|leg}}
The '''Guardian Corps''' was a formation of [[war-robot]]s employed by the military of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]]. Numbering one thousand war-robots, the Guardian Corps were transported by the [[treasure ship]] ''[[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|Queen of Ranroon]]'' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] to guard the [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|373|Guardian Corps}}</ref> On Dellalt, the Guardian Corps were maintained by the "[[Survivors (Dellalt)|Survivors]],"<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> who were descended from ''Queen of Ranroon''{{'s}} original crew and honor guards.<ref name="EC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were on Dellalt and came up against the Guardian Corps. The Survivors used the war-robots against a [[J'uoch's mining camp|mining operation]] led by [[J'uoch]]. The Guardian Corps were defeated when they marched over a bridge, creating a harmonic resonance that caused the bridge to crumble. The Guardian Corps fell into the ravine below and were destroyed.<ref name="HSATLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
